policy: Official documentation review and proposed pilots only. No software was installed, no benchmark was run, and no license/security assessment is complete.

headline.zh: 量化研究实验平台：数据处理、预测模型与研究工作流
headline.en: Quant research workflows across data, models and experiments

best_for.zh: 具备 Python 与量化研究经验、需要可审计实验基线的研究者
best_for.en: Python-capable quant researchers building auditable experiment baselines

not_for.zh: 直接连接账户执行真实交易、或希望用回测收益证明稳定盈利的人
not_for.en: Unattended live trading or inferring future returns from a backtest

capabilities.zh: 官方描述支持量化数据处理、机器学习建模与研究实验
capabilities.en: The project documents quantitative data workflows and machine-learning research

capabilities.zh: 文档介绍了研究组件与教程，适合设计基线实验
capabilities.en: Documentation and examples provide starting points for baseline experiments

pilot.zh: 用获授权的历史数据构建简单基线，再做时间切分和成本敏感性测试
pilot.en: Build a licensed-data baseline with chronological holdout and cost sensitivity

steps.zh: 检查数据来源、许可与时间戳，固定样本和环境
steps.en: Verify dataset rights and timestamps; pin inputs and environment

steps.zh: 设置朴素基准模型，严格隔离训练与测试区间
steps.en: Establish a simple baseline and enforce temporal separation

steps.zh: 记录 OOS 指标、成本后结果、漂移和失败案例
steps.en: Log out-of-sample metrics, costs, drift and failures

metrics.zh: 数据泄漏检查、OOS 指标、成本敏感性、复现偏差
metrics.en: Leakage checks, out-of-sample metrics, cost sensitivity, reproduction drift

limitations.zh: 文档中的模型与案例不能证明未来预测力；上线前需审查数据许可、序列化资产加载与执行安全
limitations.en: Documented models do not establish predictive value; assess data rights, artifact loading and execution permissions

headline.zh: 面向长任务的有状态 Agent 编排与人工审批
headline.en: Stateful orchestration for long-running agents and approval flows

best_for.zh: 需要状态恢复、人工审批和多阶段 Agent 执行的开发团队
best_for.en: Engineering teams building stateful multi-step agents with human oversight

not_for.zh: 无需状态管理的简单调用，或默认授予 Agent 广泛生产权限
not_for.en: Trivial one-shot calls or agents given unrestricted production privileges

capabilities.zh: 官方文档描述持久化执行和故障恢复机制
capabilities.en: Official docs describe durable execution and resumable workflows

capabilities.zh: 支持人工中断、状态检查以及有状态工作流
capabilities.en: Supports interrupts, state inspection and stateful workflows

pilot.zh: 用模拟 API 构建可中断的审批流程与故障恢复试验
pilot.en: Test interruptible human approval and recovery against a mock API

steps.zh: 构造无敏感信息的三阶段状态机和模拟工具
steps.en: Build a three-stage state machine with synthetic tools

steps.zh: 注入超时、失败和重试，记录每次状态变化
steps.en: Inject timeouts, failures and retries; record transitions

steps.zh: 验证未经人工批准不能触发受保护动作
steps.en: Confirm protected actions never run before human approval

metrics.zh: 恢复成功率、重复副作用数量、审批绕过次数、调用成本
metrics.en: Recovery rate, duplicate side effects, bypass count and call cost

limitations.zh: 编排框架不能代替模型评估、安全隔离或外部工具授权；持久化可能增加数据治理成本
limitations.en: Orchestration is not model evaluation, isolation or authorization; persistence needs data governance

headline.zh: 以 React 代码驱动视频模板、动画与批量渲染
headline.en: Code-first React video templates, animation and batch rendering

best_for.zh: 能够维护 React/Node 环境、需要批量制作原创视频模板的团队
best_for.en: Teams comfortable with React/Node creating reusable original video templates

not_for.zh: 希望零配置一键自动代替内容事实核查、素材授权和发布审核的人
not_for.en: One-click replacement for editorial review, licensing and publishing approval

capabilities.zh: 官方 README 展示代码驱动、交互编辑及程序化视频制作路径
capabilities.en: The official README documents agentic, interactive and programmatic creation

capabilities.zh: 官方文档涵盖渲染、字幕、转场、模板和部署选项
capabilities.en: Docs cover rendering, captions, transitions, templates and deployment options

pilot.zh: 使用自有录制素材和合成研究数据生成 9:16 信息型短视频
pilot.en: Produce a 9:16 explainer using owned assets and synthetic research data

steps.zh: 准备原创脚本、素材授权清单与可核验引用
steps.en: Prepare original script, asset rights checklist and citations

steps.zh: 制作可复用 React 模板并输出静音/字幕对照稿
steps.en: Render reusable React template with caption/silent checks

steps.zh: 人工复核画面、字幕、金融内容合规后才发布
steps.en: Require human review of visuals, captions and financial claims

metrics.zh: 渲染耗时、字幕错误数、逐帧溢出、人工修改次数
metrics.en: Render time, caption errors, frame overflow and manual edits

limitations.zh: 第三方字体、音乐、素材和渲染服务可能有独立授权/费用；需核对 Remotion 当前许可证条款
limitations.en: Assets, fonts, audio and rendering may have separate fees or rights; verify current Remotion license terms

headline.zh: 可定制客户数据结构、工作流和部署方式的 CRM
headline.en: Customizable CRM data models, workflows and deployment choices

best_for.zh: 需要自定义客户对象、审批和私有部署评估的技术团队
best_for.en: Technical teams evaluating custom CRM objects, review workflows and self-hosting

not_for.zh: 不准备管理个人数据治理、权限和客户联系授权的团队
not_for.en: Teams unable to govern personal data, permissions and contact consent

capabilities.zh: 官方 README 描述 CRM 自定义对象、字段与视图的开发方式
capabilities.en: The official README covers custom objects, fields and views

capabilities.zh: 官方文档区分云端和自托管部署及应用扩展路径
capabilities.en: Official docs distinguish cloud/self-hosted deployment and app extension

pilot.zh: 把本仓库合成授权线索示例导入隔离模拟 CRM，并验证撤回和去重
pilot.en: Connect synthetic consent-gated leads to a mock CRM and test revocation

steps.zh: 定义匿名线索 ID、同意用途和撤回字段，不输入真实客户信息
steps.en: Define anonymous IDs, purpose and opt-out fields with no real personal data

steps.zh: 先测模拟 API 去重、权限、重试和错误补偿
steps.en: Test mock API deduplication, access rules, retries and rollback

steps.zh: 在任何真实客户接入前评估存储、删除、通知和法律要求
steps.en: Review storage, deletion, notice and legal requirements before real integration

metrics.zh: 撤回执行正确率、重复记录率、错误恢复及删除覆盖率
metrics.en: Revocation correctness, duplicate rate, recovery and deletion coverage

limitations.zh: 公开功能文档不代表已完成本地部署；真实 CRM 会带来个人数据与授权管理责任
limitations.en: Documentation is not proof of deployment; real CRM involves privacy and consent obligations
